'''Starfeld Industries''' was a corporation that produced the [[Z-10 Seeker-class scout ship|Z-10 ''Seeker'']], which was originally intended as a scouting/trade vessel. When it began seeing use in roles as a high-speed delivery freighter and blockade runner, the corporation capitalized on the market they stumbled into with the dedicated Starfeld [[ZH-25 Questor-class light freighter|ZH-25 ''Questor''-class]] freighter.
